text:
alex: Seeing weird cross-org quicklinks in console after rapid org-switching. Repro steps below. Minimal repro on staging.

alex: Steps:
1) sign in as user A
2) open org A quicklinks
3) switch to org B rapidly (top-left) twice
4) open quicklinks again -> shows org A rows

alex: Logs from console proxy:
```
2024-09-12T15:12:34Z proxy WARN route-mismatch: X-Org-Hash 0x7f49 != active 0x2bcd for session=... cache_key=pf_v3:0x7f49
```

jess: can you grab full header dump? suspect cache key derivation changed in prefetch_v3 hashing PR.

alex: header dump:
```
GET /api/quicklinks
X-Org-Id: 6789
X-Org-Hash: 0x7f49
X-Session: s_abc123
```

maria: ops-bot shows a deploy of prefetch-service at 15:11:50 -> canary rolled at 15:11:55

ops-bot: deploy: prefetch-service prefetch_v3_hashing canary=on sha=abcdef1 user=jen

kevin: got telemetry — route_mispredicts spiked ~400% at 15:12, and quota_route_hits for shared-cache also up. strongly suspect hash collision/entropy change.

jess: possible quick fix: add owner-org prefix to cache key until we rollback. Patch idea:
```
cache_key = f"pf_v3:{owner_org}:{hashvalue}"
```

devops-bot: rolling back canary on prefetch-service now -> rollback started 15:18

alex: confirmed staging quicklinks back to expected after rollback. No cross-org rows after 15:20.

maria: next steps: 1) create postmortem 2) add guard in prefetch to assert owner_org == request_org when serving cached payloads 3) notif product and support for possible customer surface

kevin: I'll open the PR to add owner-org in the key + add unit test for quick switch. Assign to @jess for review.

jess: on it. Also let's add an eval in console e2e to do rapid org switch test.

alex: filing a short incident thread in incidents channel and tagging SRE for rollout gating. Thanks team :thumbsup:
